_comment: These exist so a scene change can be measured at FIXED poses: a flight moves
the camera, so a before/after comparison across flights would confound the
scene with whatever route each run happened to fly.
Chosen to cover what the mission's own camera sees: interior altitude (1.5 m,
the declared hover), inside each room and the vestibule, at yaws that put a
wall in front, to the side and along the room -- so the ruled [0.5, 6.0] m
depth band is exercised from ~1 m to ~5.6 m rather than at one distance.
Deliberately generic: no pose aims at the target or the decoy, so nothing in
this tool encodes where the scene's answer is.
world_zero: floor level, ENU: x north, y west, z up

poses.note: the declared spawn column, facing the shared wall at 1 m
closer to the doorway wall, forward view
room 1 centre, far wall at 2.55 m
room 1 centre, side wall at 2.55 m
room 1 back, far wall at 4.35 m -- the mid band
room 2 centre, far wall at 2.55 m
room 2 centre, looking back at the shared wall
room 2 back, far wall at 4.45 m
room 2 back, looking the length of the scene at 5.6 m
